scope: Targeted browser interactions using synthetic learner QA-FIX-01. Hardware audio and physical mobile devices were not retested.

results.actual: Punctuation-only passage rejected; recording and manual scoring disabled.

results.evidence: Editing the compared transcript cleared all word marks and blocked the old result.
Recomparison produced 10 CWPM / 100%; acknowledgement was required; save appeared in the report.
Saving a Hindi connected-story reading from an English-level-1 report switched the report to Hindi level 2 and displayed 77 CWPM.
Export report explains that the CSV includes all languages and levels and labels the download accordingly.
A wrong choice marked score 2 was rejected as Invalid backup; learner and session counts remained 1 / 2.
A different learner ID with a case/space variant of the saved code was rejected with Learner code conflict.
A Hindi sounds check resumed at question 2 after reload, saved one independent and one supported answer, then remained in Progress with no draft banner after another reload.
